Mirzapur film achieves strong box office opening

The film 'Mirzapur' has achieved a strong opening at the box office, earning over ₹19 crore by evening shows on its first day. Despite the release of 'Hanuman Ansh', 'Mirzapur' reportedly garnered a significant opening. The film is also reported to have broken the records of 'Saiyaara' and 'Awarapan 2'. 'Hanuman Ansh' is nearing ₹100 crore.
